name: sign-in
title: Sign-in
description: The pages of an app's sign-in on @hachej/boring-ui-kit/signin: SignInPage (e-mail and password, Google when set, account creation by invitation or by the one-use first-owner link, resuming an assistant's authorization), ConsentPage (the « Allow » of an assistant's sign-in to /mcp), PeopleList (the owner's invitation list), useSignedIn and studioNavItem (the « Studio » entry for an app's owners). English and French, labels overridable.
